general_enquiry_sample.method: subject+key_topics keyword heuristics (no LLM); LLM would recover more

verdicts.whats_wrong: intent only 80% populated (20% of analyzed emails have NULL intent — never classified) AND general_enquiry=52% of corpus (65% of classified); sample shows ~39% of the catch-all is recoverable sub-intent (quote/order/delivery/invoice/artwork...). Lifecycle analysis on current taxonomy reads mostly general_enquiry.
verdicts.fix: re-classify the 147,796 general_enquiry emails PLUS the ~56K NULL-intent emails with a finer taxonomy (~12 sub-intents incl. delivery, invoice, file-delivery, scheduling)

verdicts.whats_wrong: no substance field anywhere in schema; summary/justification exist but are descriptive, not the Q3 classification
verdicts.fix: new LLM pass over reply emails (start: outbound replies for AM-side, inbound for contact-side); thread-aware prompt
verdicts.cost_estimate: ~$176 inbound-only or ~$282 full corpus (start with the 2-3 pilot customers' threads ~ <$5)

verdicts.needs: numeric per-email score to trend over time
verdicts.whats_wrong: sentiment_score: 284 non-zero of 281,771 — the column exists but the pipeline never writes a real value; categorical sentiment is 71% neutral (no separation, confirmed in won/lost analysis)
verdicts.fix: populate numeric score in the standard per-email pass (prompt change) + backfill
verdicts.cost_estimate: ~$282 full backfill — LOW ROI: categorical sentiment carried zero signal in won/lost; complaint-intent + urgency already capture extremes

verdicts.needs: tone / structure / specificity / consultative-ratio on outbound
verdicts.whats_wrong: no tone/structure/specificity fields; only timing + volume exist for AM behaviour
verdicts.fix: new LLM pass over OUTBOUND emails only (105,980)
verdicts.cost_estimate: ~$106 (105,980 outbound x $0.001) — but deferred per won/lost evidence: substance (Q3) first, tone after substance validates

reextraction_shortlist.extraction: Intent re-classification of the general_enquiry catch-all (147,796 emails, ~$148)
reextraction_shortlist.why: Cheapest (only the catch-all, not the corpus), unlocks the roadmap's #1 feature (intent-lifecycle — the strongest won/lost separator), and the audit shows ~39% of the bucket is recoverable signal. CONFIRMS the prior.

reextraction_shortlist.extraction: Single COMBINED pass over full corpus (~$300-400): finer intent + Q3 substance + entity fields (topics/products/competitors/buying signals) in one prompt
reextraction_shortlist.why: The systemic finding (rich fields empty at scale) means three planned passes touch the same emails; one combined pass costs marginally more than the intent-only pass but back-fills everything the catalog assumes exists. Tradeoff: bigger prompt = more validation work up front.

reextraction_shortlist.extraction: Q3 response-substance pilot on 2-3 customers' reply threads (<$5), then inbound-wide (~$176)
reextraction_shortlist.why: Only feature that explains the TPA null result (relationship accounts flat on metadata); pilot first because the prompt needs validation against real threads.
Needed for AM2 coaching, but unfalsifiable until substance ships — sequence after Q3.
Deprioritise: categorical sentiment showed zero separation; extremes already covered by complaint-intent + urgency. Populate-or-drop the column to stop the silent-zero trap.

systemic_finding: TWO-GENERATION PIPELINE: the rich extraction fields (key_topics 0.4%, summary 0.5%, products_mentioned 0.2%, competitors_mentioned ~0%, buying_signals 0.1%, action_items 0.1%, thread_role 0.4%, business_signal_score 0.2%) are populated on only ~1-2K early emails — the bulk backfill pass wrote ONLY intent/sentiment/urgency (80%) and business_signal (30%). Consequences: (a) the insight-catalog 'cheap win' of aggregating competitors_mentioned is MOOT — the field is empty at scale; (b) any roadmap item assuming key_topics/summary/buying_signals exists at scale is actually a DOESN'T-EXIST; (c) a single combined re-extraction pass (finer intent + substance + the entity fields) over the corpus (~$282-400 with a longer prompt) may be better value than three sequential passes — same emails, one read.

general_enquiry_30.method: manual read of 30 random snippets (model judgment), 300-char SQL-side truncation
examples_mislabeled: GE04 "any update on this quote?" -> quote_followup
GE21 "wrong dimensions, hopefully not too late" -> quote_revision
GE22 "waiting on approval of art" -> artwork_approval_chase
GE13 "invoice paid, will it be done this week?" -> payment+order_status
general_enquiry_30.note: Manual read finds ~57% real signal vs the 39% keyword-heuristic floor — the catch-all hides MORE signal than the heuristic estimate. Two extra classes needed in the finer taxonomy: auto_notification (courier/file-download/calendar) and internal_vendor (supplier/internal ops traffic that should be excluded from customer insight rollups).

positive_10.verdict: ~50-70% face-valid; fires on payment-receipt templates and courier "Great News" autotext

negative_10.verdict: ~80% face-valid; negative is the more trustworthy pole (complaints, supply friction, disputes)

sentiment_20.overall: categorical sentiment usable as a NEGATIVE-event detector only; positive pole is polluted by politeness/auto templates

partB_judgments.extracted_references_8: 8/8 plausible; quote numbers match subjects; version suffix correctly stripped (Q704972v3 -> Q704972)
partB_judgments.business_signal_8: ~3/8 plausible. "missed_opportunity" stamped on a routine quote send, an internal machine issue, and a normal estimate request; "revenue_at_risk" on an internal proofs-process gripe. LOW TRUST at its 30% population — do not build insights on business_signal without re-extraction.

partB_coverage_findings.ai_row_vs_intent_gap: 91.7% of emails have an AI row but only 75.1% have intent — ~33K rows analyzed without classification

mailbox_gaps.Nic Outlook Mac: 17.8% of 24,081 classified — the restored history was NOT backfilled through the classifier

partB_coverage_findings.month_gaps: 2024-01..2024-06 (26-59% classified) and 2026-03 (18,248 emails, 55% — Nic restore landing)
partB_coverage_findings.thread_status: only 9,271 rows for client, 89% status=dropped, last_email_intent populated on 0 — thread-level feature layer effectively unpopulated/stale
partB_coverage_findings.email_response_metrics: 39,173 rows, median response 0.1h, 1,155 auto-replies flagged — usable but covers ~20% of emails

intentless_diagnosis.finding: The 56,465 intent-less rows are processing_status='skipped' with a pre_filter reason in error_message, ZERO tokens, no model call — a deliberate pre-filter, NOT a failed/dropped classification. Breakdown: folder_trash 41,992 (74%), trivial_body 9,494, rule_based_or_auto_reply 2,474, folder_spam 815, automated_pattern 520, folder_drafts 478, bounce 401, forward_only 193, spam 68.
intentless_diagnosis.long_email_hypothesis: DISPROVEN — skipped emails skew SHORT (body p50 804 vs 2,126 classified; 19% empty). No timeout/truncation on long emails; re-extraction would not lose substantive threads via this path.
intentless_diagnosis.write_path: sound — records why it skipped; a new pass should REUSE this pre-filter, not re-pay for trash.

real_gaps.no_ai_row: 16,367 emails have NO ai row at all — 16,270 are Nic Outlook Mac (restored history never run through the pipeline). Normal length (p50 1,628) = real content. THIS is the genuine classification gap.
real_gaps.folder_trash_pre_filter: 41,992 emails skipped as folder_trash — verify the Trash filter is not eating real customer threads (sync/retention artifact). Data-hygiene spot check, not a write bug.
real_gaps.client_id_inconsistency: ~100K ai rows tagged client=CARBON8 point at emails not tagged CARBON8 in emails table (0 true orphans, but client_id mismatch across the two tables) — cleanup candidate, non-blocking.

trash_prefilter_verdict.gate: DO NOT REUSE folder_trash AS A PRE-FILTER — it is contaminated with real customer mail
trash_prefilter_verdict.sample_read: ~12-13 of 25 are genuine customer/business threads (quote requests, approvals, spec discussions, follow-ups) from real customer domains incl. Studio Odea, Fourth Wall, UNSW, Delivery, monogram.partners, Society of the Sacred Heart, Cartier. The rest: newsletters, calendar accepts, file-transfer notifications, utility/vendor noise, internal ops.
trash_prefilter_verdict.aggregate_corroboration: Top trash sender domains are dominated by CUSTOMER domains — hhglobal.com (342), thepropertyagency.com.au (216), centuria.com.au (263), emilyziz.com (223), fourthwall, frostcollective, curriegroup, unsw.edu.au, integritylife — i.e. TOP customers. Only 7% are noreply/mailer/bounce (the truly safe skip pattern); 41% internal carbon8 (mixed ops); ~52% external, much of it real.
trash_prefilter_verdict.root_cause: folder=Trash here reflects AM mailbox HYGIENE (handled-then-deleted) and sync of the Trash folder, NOT irrelevance. Folder location is not a relevance signal for this client.
trash_prefilter_verdict.impact: ~42K emails skipped on folder_trash; at ~50% real that is ~20K genuine customer threads (quotes, approvals) currently invisible to ALL intent/AI-dependent insight. This is LARGER than Nic's 16K no-row gap.

recommendation.drop_filter: Remove folder_trash from the pre-filter skip set.
recommendation.keep_filters: KEEP content-based skips (spam, bounce_or_delivery_failure, rule_based_or_auto_reply, automated_pattern, trivial_body, forward_only, folder_drafts, noreply/mailer-pattern) — those are legitimate.
recommendation.reextraction_scope: Re-include the ~42K folder_trash emails, run them through the CONTENT pre-filters (drops the ~50% genuine junk), recovering ~20K real customer emails. Combined real target = Nic 16K no-row + ~20K recovered-from-trash ~= 36K emails ~= $36 at $0.001. Still nowhere near $400.
recommendation.caveat_on_prior_work: metadata analyses (revenue-at-risk, open-quotes) used the emails table directly and were unaffected; only intent/AI-dependent views (intent mix, won/lost intent) were missing this ~20K — those may shift slightly once trash is re-classified.
